support.title: How can we help?
support.subtitle: We reply in Telegram within minutes or by email within 24 hours.

defaultFaq.a: All your generations are available in your /app account right after payment. An email arrives within 1 minute.

defaultFaq.q: How do I get a refund?
defaultFaq.a: If something went wrong, message us on Telegram or email with your order number. We reply within 24 hours.

defaultFaq.q: Where do I download processed photos?
defaultFaq.a: Each generation has a full-resolution download link. The link stays active for 72 hours.

defaultFaq.q: Email or Telegram notification didn’t arrive?
defaultFaq.a: Check the Spam folder. If you don’t see it, refresh /app — your generations will appear there.

defaultFaq.q: How do you improve the photo?
defaultFaq.a: The service improves your photo while preserving identity. Every processed image is labeled as AI-generated — in EXIF and via a watermark.
